displayPattern: PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic display in Goodman service manual RS6200007 r27 (ASXC, DSXC, GSXC condensing units and ASZC, DSZC, GSZC heat pumps). Digit 3 is blank. Digit 2 is d and digit 1 is 4. The code is d4
meaning: Invalid shared data. The air conditioner or heat pump fails to operate. The chart says the code clears once data is loaded.
causes: Shared data on the Bluetooth Shared Data Loader BTSDL01 has been rejected
diySteps: Write down d4. The chart says this code clears once data is loaded
Technician: verify communicating or legacy wiring and re-populate the correct shared data for this model with BTSDL01, or wire the system as a legacy system
Technician: turn power off before inserting or removing the loader
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. d4 is rejected shared data from the loader, not an airflow code.
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
